title: 第14章 灵药学
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
清晨七点，闹钟响了两遍，陈峰才从床上爬起来。

    昨晚修行到凌晨一点多，一株灰伞肺菇全部吃完，虽然面板数据没有提升。

    但他估计自己应该又提升了0.03左右的体质。

    陈峰揉了揉脸，从床头摸过手机。

    屏幕上挂着两条未读消息，是邻居姐姐周柔发来的。

    周柔：“小峰，今天周六我加班，在公司。你过来公司找我吧。”

    周柔：“地址发你了，天衡医药锦城分部，到了跟前台说找我就行。”

    陈峰这才想起，之前答应过柔姐，周六去找她一趟。

    这几天事情太多，他都给忘了。

    他回了条消息：“好，马上过来。”

    随后起身洗漱，换了身干净衣服，揣上手机和钥匙就出了门。

    ……

    锦城不算大。

    放在全国排不上号，搁东湖省里头也就中等水平。

    人口三百来万，经济说不上好也说不上差，能供出一所一本的锦城大学，已经算这座城市最拿得出手的名片了。

    陈峰从出租屋出来，坐了四十分钟公交到市中心。

    下了车，沿着中央大街往东走了五百米，一栋二十层的玻璃幕墙写字楼出现在视野里。

    楼体正面，四个烫金大字——“天衡医药”。

    天衡医药集团，全国排名前十的灵药企业。

    旗下产品线覆盖外伤治疗、体质增强、灵材加工等十几个领域，分公司遍布全国三十多个省份。

    陈峰之前花五万块钱买的那瓶二级外伤治疗喷雾，就是天衡出品的。

    当然，眼前这栋楼只是锦城分部，规模远比不上总部，但在锦城这种二线城市里，已经是数一数二的大企业了。

    陈峰的邻居姐姐周柔，就在这儿上班。

    周柔虽然不是他亲姐，但两家是十几年的邻居。

    陈峰父母早亡，从小吃过周家不少饭，叫了十几年的“姐”，比亲的也差不了多少了。

    后来陈峰考上锦城大学，周柔恰好也在锦城工作，便一直在照应他。

    后来周柔和跟分公司总经理的女儿余霜混成了闺蜜，一路高升，现在直接做了余霜的私人秘书。

    陈峰走进大厅，跟前台报了周柔的名字。

    前台打了个内线电话，然后指引他去三楼会客室等。

    没等多久，门被推开了。

    “小峰。”

    周柔走进来，穿着一身藏蓝色的职业套裙，头发盘起来，整个人精明干练。

    但笑起来的时候还是那副温温柔柔的样子，跟以前没什么两样。

    “姐。”陈峰站起来。

    周柔在他对面坐下，上下打量了他两眼，眉头一皱。

    “瘦了。”

    “没有，壮了。”

    “壮？你壮哪了？”

    周柔拍了他胳膊一下，“脸都凹进去了，是不是又没好好吃饭？”

    “真没有，天天吃食堂，有荤有素。”

    周柔哼了一声，显然不太信。

    “说吧，你之前旷课怎么回事？你班导师都打电话给我了，连续旷了半个多月，你是不想上学了？”

    “身体不舒服，休息了一阵。”

    陈峰早就编好了说辞：“已经跟老师解释过了，梁老师同意我自己安排时间，不影响期末考核就行。”

    “真的？”

    “真的，你要不信可以打电话问。”

    周柔盯着他看了几秒，没再追问。

    她从包里掏出一个牛皮纸信封，推到陈峰面前。

    “拿着。”

    陈峰拿起来捏了捏，厚厚一沓。

    “这是……”

    “一万块。”

    陈峰立刻把信封推了回去：“姐，我不缺钱。”

    周柔又推回来：“少跟我客气。”

    “真不用，我最近干了点零工，手头宽裕。”

    “零工能有多少钱？你一个大一学生。”

    周柔直接把信封塞进他帆布包的侧袋里，“我叫你跑这一趟就是怕你拒绝，当面给你，你总不好意思扔回来吧。”

    陈峰张了张嘴。

    “别跟我争。”周柔语气平淡，一脸认真，“你好好读书，缺什么跟我说。”

    陈峰微微沉默。

    说实话，他现在既缺钱，又不缺钱。

    如果把昨夜收获来的血根草卖出一部分，他手头立刻就能宽裕起来。

    但现在这批血根草他要留着突破境界，不能动。

    而他现在账户里，又只剩下了不到四千块钱，其中还有三千是订购武器要支付的尾款……

    算下来，他身上还能用的钱就剩不到一千块……

    他心中微叹，抬头看向周柔。

    “谢谢姐。”
content_en:
At seven o'clock in the morning, the alarm clock rang twice before Chen Feng got up from the bed.

    I practiced until about one o'clock in the morning last night and ate all the P. cinerea mushrooms, although the panel data did not improve.

    But he estimated that his physical fitness should have improved by about 0.03.

    Chen Feng rubbed his face and touched his cell phone from the bedside.

    There are two unread messages hanging on the screen, from the neighbor sister Zhou Rou.

    Zhou Rou: "Xiao Feng, I'm working overtime today and Saturday at the company. Come to the company to find me."

    Zhou Rou: "I sent you the address, Tianheng Medical Jincheng Branch. Just tell me at the front desk when you get there."

    Chen Feng then remembered that he had promised Sister Rou that he would go to see her on Saturday.

    There were so many things going on these days that he had forgotten all about them.

    He sent back a message: "Okay, come right over."

    Then he got up to wash up, changed into clean clothes, put his phone and keys and went out.

    …

    Jincheng is not that big.

    It's not ranked high in the country, but it's only average in Donghu Province.

    The population is over three million, and the economy is neither good nor bad. Being able to support a Jincheng University is already considered the city's best business card.

    Chen Feng came out of the rental house and took the bus to the city center for forty minutes.

    After getting off the car and walking five hundred meters east along Central Street, a twenty-story glass-walled office building appeared in view.

    On the front of the building, there are four large gilded characters - "Tianheng Medicine".

    Tianheng Pharmaceutical Group is one of the top ten elixir companies in the country.

    Its product lines cover more than a dozen fields such as trauma treatment, physical enhancement, and spiritual material processing, and its branches are located in more than 30 provinces across the country.

    The bottle of Level 2 trauma treatment spray that Chen Feng spent 50,000 yuan on was produced by Tianheng.

    Of course, the building in front of you is just the Jincheng branch, far smaller than the headquarters, but in a second-tier city like Jincheng, it is already one of the top big companies.

    Chen Feng's neighbor sister, Zhou Rou, works here.

    Although Zhou Rou is not his biological sister, the two families have been neighbors for more than ten years.

    Chen Feng's parents died young, and he had eaten a lot of food from the Zhou family since he was a child. The person he called "sister" for more than ten years was not much worse than his relatives.

    Later, Chen Feng was admitted to Jincheng University, and Zhou Rou happened to work in Jincheng, so she kept taking care of him.

    Later, Zhou Rou and Yu Shuang, the daughter of the general manager of the branch, became best friends. They rose through the ranks and now directly serve as Yu Shuang's personal secretary.

    Chen Feng walked into the lobby and told the front desk Zhou Rou's name.

    The front desk made an intercom call and directed him to the reception room on the third floor to wait.

    Before long, the door was pushed open.

    "Xiao Feng."

    Zhou Rou walked in, wearing a navy blue professional skirt, her hair tied up, looking smart and capable.

    But when he smiles, he still looks gentle and gentle, no different from before.

    "Sister." Chen Feng stood up.

    Zhou Rou sat down opposite him, looked him up and down, and frowned.

    "lost weight."

    "No, I'm getting stronger."

    "Strong? How strong are you?"

    Zhou Rou patted his arm and said, "Your face is sunken. Did you not eat well again?"

    "No, I eat in the canteen every day, with both meat and vegetables."

    Zhou Rou snorted, obviously not believing it.

    "Tell me, why were you absent from class before? Your class teacher called me and you were absent for more than half a month. Do you not want to go to school anymore?"

    "I'm not feeling well. I'm going to rest for a while."

    Chen Feng had already made up his excuse: "I have already explained it to the teacher. Teacher Liang agrees that I can arrange my own time and it will not affect the final assessment."

    "Really?"

    "Really, if you don't believe it, you can call and ask."

    Zhou Rou stared at him for a few seconds and didn't ask any more questions.

    She took out a brown paper envelope from her bag and pushed it in front of Chen Feng.

    "Take it."

    Chen Feng picked it up and squeezed it, making a thick pile.

    "This is..."

    "Ten thousand dollars."

    Chen Feng immediately pushed the envelope back: "Sister, I'm not short of money."

    Zhou Rou pushed back: "Don't be polite to me."

    "It's really not necessary. I've been doing some odd jobs recently and I have plenty of money."

    "How much money can you make from a part-time job? You are a freshman."

    Zhou Rou directly stuffed the envelope into the side pocket of his canvas bag, "I asked you to make this trip because I was afraid you would refuse. If I give it to you in person, you would be too embarrassed to throw it back."

    Chen Feng opened his mouth.

    "Don't argue with me." Zhou Rou said calmly, with a serious look on her face, "Study hard and tell me what you need."

    Chen Feng was slightly silent.

    To be honest, he is neither short of money nor short of money now.

    If he sells part of the bloodroot harvested last night, he will immediately have a lot of money.

    But now he wants to keep this batch of bloodroot grass to break through the realm and cannot touch it.

    And now he only has less than 4,000 yuan left in his account, of which 3,000 yuan is the final payment for ordering weapons...

    After all, he only had less than a thousand dollars left that could be used...

    He sighed in his heart and looked up at Zhou Rou.

    "Thank you, sister."
